title: quality: Gate ignored fallible results
intent: Add a reproducible gate preventing ignored fallible production results and silent-discard patterns from being introduced without explicit non-production or justified exception status.

reason: Gate wiring belongs in root CI/Moon/scripts and possibly xtask; production crate list is the scan domain, not necessarily edit domain.

notes: script path is proposed if implementation chooses dedicated scan; xtask gate is optional and should be avoided if stale command-center surface is out of scope.

risk: xtask is first-party tooling; contract must decide if it is production for this bead or documented exception domain.

items.name: Moon task graph
items.contract: ignored-fallible-results gate must be runnable and included in canonical verification path

items.name: Cargo lint contract
items.contract: workspace lints must deny unused_must_use and clippy::let_underscore_must_use for participating crates

items.name: scripted static scan
items.contract: must fail on production silent-discard fixtures and avoid non-production false positives

items.name: xtask command-center gates
items.contract: optional gate enum/command must match actual script/Moon command and evidence path if used

requirements.text: A reproducible command fails on ignored fallible production results.
Gate covers documented silent-discard patterns not reliably caught by Rust unused_must_use.
Existing intentional exceptions are explicit, non-production, or justified with machine-readable/path-bound rationale.
Canonical CI/Moon verification path runs the gate so AI changes cannot bypass it.
Gate avoids broad false positives in tests, benches, fuzz, proof artifacts, and bead evidence unless contract intentionally includes them.

blockers: Dependency vb-qi37.12.2 is blocked and may leave known production silent-discard candidates in current tree.
xtask Gate::ForbiddenScan and Gate::HotpathScan reference scripts not found by glob; avoid relying on stale gate patterns without repair.

dependency_audit_required_if_changed: If Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock or tool dependencies change, State 11 must include supply-chain evidence; otherwise not required by this scope.

modes.evidence: machine-gate-report.md showing pass and negative-fixture failure evidence

formal_lanes.tla_plus: not expected unless contract introduces temporal behavior
formal_lanes.verus: not expected unless scanner has verified parser semantics
formal_lanes.kani: optional only for nontrivial scanner library logic
formal_lanes.miri: not required unless unsafe/FFI introduced; unsafe is forbidden
formal_lanes.proptest: recommended for scanner classification if implemented as Rust logic rather than shell

needed_by_contract: Define exact silent-discard taxonomy, production path domain, exception format, required negative fixtures, and whether current production candidates are blocked debt or immediate gate failures.
do_not_do: Do not write production fixes in State 3.
Do not claim current production tree is clean without reconciling observed main.rs silent-discard candidates.
Do not rely solely on existing workspace lints; bead asks for a reproducible gate including documented silent-discard patterns.
